decisions.reason: Technical validation and correction within existing goals can proceed; the pilot records execution and independent verification without requiring fresh approval for each technical lesson.
A technical lesson may be revised or revoked within its authorized role and scope based on evidence; this does not grant broader sharing permission.
Publishing private role memory outside its authorized scope changes permission and is not authorized by the existing adapter or proposal.

remaining: Do not describe the general natural-language planning or expert-routing runtime as deployed.
Measure memory's causal contribution and broader adoption benefit; stored or retrieved memory alone is not proof of benefit.
Measure human review time before making human-time-saving claims.
Run bounded validation of one existing technical lesson within its authorized scope, preserving source, test, and revision or revocation evidence.
Obtain an explicit human permission decision before any proposal to publish private role memory beyond its authorized scope.
The expertise proposal remains under review; do not implement it or treat its proposed comparisons as completed results.
